verdict.rationale: The only evidence of bulk action is a homepage marketing line saying Stark Bank lets users "make multiple payments" with cost-center segmentation and approval flows. That points to batch payments, but no API documentation shows how bulk creation works, how many items a batch can hold, or which resource types support it. Missing for 10: documented batch API endpoints or SDK methods that create or act on many items in one call, batch size limits and handling of per-item errors, bulk support beyond payments (e.g. boletos, transfers, cards), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Effortlessly make multiple payments with agility, conveniently segmented by cost centers and integrated with approval flows.
